description: Reference carry: rank 2 team named in turn 0; follow-ups say 'they'.

turns.query: Who finished second in the 2022-2023 Premier League?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_team FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2022-2023' AND tss_rank = 2;

turns.query: How many goals did they score across the season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_goals_for FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2022-2023' AND tss_rank = 2;

turns.query: How many games did they lose that season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_losses FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2022-2023' AND tss_rank = 2;
